title: Wikidata

title: Dénominations caduques des voies

usefulness: high — resolves historic street names in 19th-century texts to current streets

title: Dénominations des emprises des voies actuelles

usefulness: medium — authoritative current names and street histories; not yet joined to PLACE records

title: Plaques commémoratives

title: Lieux de tournage à Paris

usefulness: none for these five works (no adaptation shot in the period); high for recent films
notes: Queried by title for all five works and their adaptations: zero relevant records.

title: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim
contains: Geocoding of specific street addresses to OSM nodes.
usefulness: medium — house-number coordinates where Wikidata has only the street
automatable: yes — within the 1 request/second usage policy; bulk work needs a self-hosted instance or the BAN (Base Adresse Nationale)
notes: Gives the present-day position of a house number. House numbering can change; a 19th-century number is not guaranteed to be the same building.

title: data.bnf.fr / BnF catalogue général
